programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: John and his new wife, Suzanne, reach a crisis point in their marriage when one of them must drop out of college due to financial woes.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: A Christmas party at the garage is interrupted when Louie, the dispatcher teams up with Alex in a game of high-stakes poker against his cardshark brother Nick.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The taxi gang scrambles to come up with a scheme aimed at ending a one-sided romance when a determined, pretty cabbie sets her cap for Tony and joins the Sunshine Cab Co. to be near him.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex feels sympathy for a fare who’s a real loser with the women and arranges a date for the man with Elaine, who later discovers that her klutzy companion for the evening is a U.S. Congressman.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby’s career dreams come true when he lands a role in a soap opera, prompting him to throw his torn-up cabbie’s license at Louie, but the dispatcher vows to take revenge if Bobby ever comes crawling back.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: After an operation, Louie, the sharp-tongued dispatcher, panics when he has to keep a promise that he made to God during surgery to turn over a new leaf.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Mechanic Latka Gravas’ youthful and attractive mother makes her first visit to America, and after she and Alex meet and have an evening love affair, Latka assumes that he will soon be getting a new daddy.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When Alex’s ear is nearly shot off in a holdup attempt in his cab, he stuns his fellow cabbies by quitting and exchanging his driving clothes for a waiter’s tuxedo at a snobbish French restaurant.
programme.sub-title: Alex Tastes Death & Finds A Nice Restaurant

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies fall victim to a Hollywood-style roller coaster ride when a production company visits to do a film on taxi drivers. Life at the Sunshine Cab Company turns into a continual champagne and buffet festivity.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When John crashes Cab 804, the cabbies are shocked into a period of mourning, as they reminisce about the wild and memorable events that occurred when they were driving the legendary cab.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Mechanic Latka Gravas frantically works to save the cracked-up Cab 804 as the cabbies fondly recall times in the legendary auto when Alex delivered a baby, Louie beat a rich brat out of a wad of money, and Elaine met the perfect man.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a dream come true for Tony when he’s challenged by an aging ex-champ, but he has more than just a fight on his hand when the opposition unveils its secret weapon.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies are in for a comedy surprise when the small town kid Bobby befriends, Steve, lands a big role as Romeo the first day he arrives in the Big Apple.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex tells Elaine that her hectic schedule of being a mother, a cabbie and a museum employee is driving her crazy and that she should see a psychiatrist. Elaine decides that a quicker cure would be to spend the night with Alex.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby and Tony’s friendship is on the line when they become embroiled in a hilarious love triangle and attempt to outdo each other in vying for the affection of a beautiful young lady.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The overweight blind date Alex once had returned to the scene a svelte shell of her former self, and eager for the romance she yearns for with Alex
programme.sub-title: The Lighter Side Of Angela Matusa

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The riotous race of the century pits Alex against Louie in a winner-take-all bet to see who can bring in the most receipts. Lecherous Louie uses every dirty trick in the book to make sure he wins his prize—an evening with Elaine.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Elaine suddenly starts getting mysterious love letters. When she becomes intrigued by the poetic propositions, a couple of cabbies quickly claim responsibility, leaving Elaine with the hilarious task of discovering who is the amorous writer.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Louie makes a horrible first impression on girlfriend Zena’s parents on Taxi. Louie’s romance with girlfriend Zena takes an outrageous twist when she brings him home to meet her parents.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies try to make Tony a family man when they convince him to adopt the adorably precocious eight-year-old boy named Brian whom he befriended.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a hilarious shock to the cabbies when Rev. Jim brings his new pet to the garage—an over-the-hill racehorse that he bought after cashing in on the 300-to-1 long shot. However, he soon finds that it’s impossible to housebreak a horse.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby faces a humorous predicament when it becomes obvious that one of the biggest talent managers in New York is representing him because of his prowess as a lover, and not for his ability as an actor.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: In a protest against unsafe equipment, the cabbies go on strike, and Louie offers an unusual solution to the problem to shop steward Elaine.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: In a hilarious caper, Louie and the cabbies pool all their cash to buy a painting at an auction, planning to cash in big when the artist dies—but when the bidding gets too heavy, the gang turns a dignified auction into a frolicking free-for-all.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Lecherous Louie, the dispatcher, becomes a lovesick pup after his girlfriend finds another guy. He will stop at nothing to get her back, including recruiting Alex for his hilarious scheme—and the riotous shenanigans at the Sunshine Cab Co. never stop.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a riotous family reunion when Jim returns home to face his millionaire dad for the first time since he dropped out of society in the ‘60s, and Alex has his hands full with Jim’s voluptuous, overly amorous sister,

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The Taxi gang falls prey to hilarious fear for homeless Elaine’s romantic well-being when chivalrous Bobby allows her to live in his apartment while he is gone. Unexpectedly, he returns before she has found other quarters

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Hilarious sparks fly when Tony tries to fix up his divorced sister with Alex. Instead, she ends up falling for Reverend Jim and Tony goes outrageously overboard trying to break up the affair.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Lecherous Louie the dispatcher has the dubious honor of being selected by his employer’s revenge-seeking wife to be her clandestine lover, and comedic panic grips the love lair when the boss shows up unexpectedly.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Wild and crazy theatrics erupt when Tony decides to become an actor and Bobby, as his skeptical agent, is aghast when Tony lands a role because he is the right type.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.desc: When Latka Gravas is rejected by a young beauty, he sets out on an uproarious crash course to learn to be a swinging American Bachelor, a turnabout that works fantastically with the girls but turns off all of his friends at the garage.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb

programme.sub-title: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I et kappløp med tiden krysset over åtte hundre private båter Den engelske kanal for å redde de havarerte soldatene fra infernoet på strendene ved Dunkerque. Se de enkelte veteranenes ekstraordinære heltemot i et slag som endret andre verdenskrigs forløp.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: The Gathering Storm
programme.desc: The activities of nations after World War I that lead to World War II.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS

programme.title: The Charlotte Show
programme.desc: Det er ikke helt bra mellom Charlotte og Josh når hun drar til Palma for en fotoseanse. Vil Josh endelig spørre Charlotte om å bli kjæresten hans og gjøre dem til et offisielt par, eller vil hun måtte avslutte forholdet deres for godt?

programme.title: The Charlotte Show
programme.desc: Charlotte ser på premieren til 'The Charlotte' Show og holder en fest for å feire. Men når Josh ser et klipp av henne med en annen fyr i Australia, husker han på endel ting og Charlotte lurer på om han noen gang vil si 'jeg elsker deg'.

programme.title: Served! med Jade Thirlwall
programme.desc: Jade får med seg dragartistene Shea Coulee og Courtney Act på å lage matkonsepter basert på temaene 'Regnbue realitet' og 'Jentebandglam'. Gjestene inkluderer Little Mix-stjernen Leigh-Anne Pinnock og Spice Girls' Melanie C.

programme.title: Served! med Jade Thirlwall
programme.desc: Jade Thirlwall får med seg dragartistene Jodie Harsh og Baga Chipz på en kulinarisk konkurranse som dømmes av Jades mor, Norma. Gjest Todrick Hall stikker innom for å prate litt.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: En gruppe par tror de er med på en konkurranse som skal teste forholdene deres. Men det er en vri! Det er løgnere blant dem, som vil svindle pengepotten på over $100,000 fra de ekte parene.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: Parene har $25,000 i potten etter å ha stemt ut et par løgnere i den første Sannhetsseremonien. Mistankene florerer i gruppen og etterforskningen blir intens. En hemmelig allianse formes, men vil den lykkes?

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: Parene blir vant til konkurransen og forholdene testes ytterligere. Noen ender opp med å fomle, og uoverensstemmelser dukker opp. Men betyr dette automatisk at et par er falskt, eller er det ærlige feil?

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: De nye parene installerer seg og begynner å sette fart på sakene. Toris utfordring avslører sprekker i forhistorien. Dette fører til ennå økende mistenksomhet. Men for ett par blir det for mye, og de bestemmer seg for å dra.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: En splitting innen gruppen viser seg mellom de opprinnelige parene og nykommerne. Tross fortsatt etterforskning og økt mistanke har ikke premiepotten endret seg siden første dag, og frustrasjonen tiltar.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: Tori kaster ut en svært tiltrengt livline til gjengen. Sidepotten er verdt 50 000 dollar, og 75 000 ligger klare til Sannhetsseremonien. Men spillets press blir for intenst for et par, og derfor slår de opp.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: Trøbbel oppstår da Tori presenterer tre nye par som må foreta 24 timers detektivarbeid før sin første stemme i en eksplosiv Sannhetsseremoni. Kommer dette til å bety slutten for et opprinnelig par?

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: Knuten på tråden mellom OG-ene og nykommerne, vokser seg stadig større. Tori havner i en episk kamp hvor de konfronterer og tevler om å vinne gruppeimmunitet fra stmmene. Men skitten taktikk gir sjokkbølger under Sannhetsseremonien.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: Parene diskuterer sexlivet sitt under en 'kåtchat' som fører til spekulasjon om hvem som er ekte eller bløff. Særlig siden et par avslører at de ikke er monogame. Derfor koker spenningen over under Sannhetsseremonien.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love
programme.desc: Hemmelighullet ønsker flere ekser velkomne, noe som truer parenes tid i paradis. Sorinn og Lola har en eksplosiv krangel til middag. En eks' ankomst gir et par problemer da en hemmelig forlovelse blir avslørt.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love
programme.desc: Kamie tar med parene ut av huset for å ta et skjebnesprang. Forholdet til Spari og Shayla virker perfekt, men når lavmålet. En omgang 'knask eller knep' er artig, helt til Jamie er respektløs mot Thailah foran alle.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love
programme.desc: Kamie kommer med sjokkerende nyheter da parene begynner neste fase av reisen mot forlovelse. Sorinns tvilsomme ble måte å redde forholdet til Lola på, kan avslutte det. Leylahs kjærlighetstriangel får henne til å føle seg ringeaktet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love
programme.desc: Partnerne flytter ut av huset, eksene blir igjen for å arbeide med problemene sine. En tur til Hemmelighullet tvinger partnerne til å spørre seg om de har det bedre uten eksene sine. Samura utløser en eksplosiv krangel.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love
programme.desc: Da eksene gjenopplever sin første date, stiller noen spørsmålstegn ved sitt nåværende forhold. Leylah kjemper med å forbli tro mot Liam når hun tilbringer tid alene med eksen sin, Samura.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love
programme.desc: Partnerne er tilbake i huset for å oppdage hva deres andre har gjort. Under Refleksjonsseremonien, fatter Leylah en avgjørelse angående forholdet med Liam. Spari foretar et sjokkerende forslag.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love
programme.desc: Et par slutter da skandaløs oppførsel avsløres. Under en intim stund, bruker Thailah eksens navn på kjæresten.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love
programme.desc: Sparis forhold med Shayla når bristepunktet da Spari velger side i villadramatikken. En samtale med Kamie får Thailah til å stille spørsmål om sitt forhold til Jamie.

programme.desc: Kirby angriper Alexis og krever å vite hvorfor Joseph ville drepe henne. I rettsaken om foreldreretten til Danny, vitner Alexis mot Blake, som blir rasende.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Hearing - Part 2
programme.desc: Rettssaken om foreldreretten fortsetter, og Fallon vitner på vegne av broren sin, mens Sammy Jo fornærmer eksmannen. Fallon drar til Montana for å grave i Adams fortid. Alexis' leilighet blir endevendt.

programme.title: Dynasty: Tender Comrades
programme.desc: Steven og Claudia gifter seg, og dommeren henlegger saken om foreldreretten. Blake tilbyr Krystle en PR-jobb. Adam lurer Alexis til å signere blanke dokumenter.

programme.title: Dynasty: Tracy
programme.desc: Adam fabrikerer en falsk anklage om at Alexis sto bak forgiftningen, og Blake truer med å offentliggjøre historien. Mark angriper Krystle.

programme.title: Dynasty: Dex
programme.desc: Jeff anklager Alexis for å forsøke å drepe ham og tar tilbake aksjene sine. Mark blir bodyguard for Alexis. Dex Dexter, sønnen til et styremedlem, foreslår at han og Alexis danner en forretningsforbindelse.

programme.title: Dynasty: Peter De Vilbis
programme.desc: Dex fortsetter sin innsats for å vinne Alexis. Jeff får vite at Adam voldtok Kirby. Krystle stortrives i PR-jobben. Fallon møter en spennende millionær på veddeløpsbanen.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Proposal
programme.desc: Dex slår Alexis i kampen om en oljekontrakt. Jeff konfronterer Adam om Kirbys graviditet. Krystle sier ja til Blakes frieri. Del 1

programme.title: Dynasty: Carousel
programme.desc: Dex slår Alexis i kampen om en oljekontrakt. Jeff konfronterer Adam om Kirbys graviditet. Krystle sier ja til Blakes frieri. Del 2

programme.title: Dynasty: The Wedding
programme.desc: Adam frir til Kirby, som har til hensikt å skille seg fra Jeff. Tracy overtaler Krystle til å gi henne selskapets kredittkort og konfidensielle filer. Peter prøver seg på Claudia.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Ring
programme.desc: En fremmed hilser på lille Danny og vet hva han heter. Claudia blir bekymret og flytter familien til herskapshuset. Peter DeVilbis' arkitekt hinter om playboyens rusproblem. Kirbys hånd hovner opp.

programme.title: Dynasty: Lancelot
programme.desc: Kirbys helseproblemer fortsetter. Peter oppfordrer Fallon til å prøve kokain. Tracy saboterer Krystle på kontoret for å vinne Blake over på sin side. Veddeløpshesten Allegre blir stjålet.

programme.title: Dynasty: Seizure
programme.desc: Blake mottar et løsepengekrav for hesten. Peter kunngjør at han skal gifte seg med Fallon. Dex og Alexis blander forretninger med fonøyelser. Kirby får et anfall.

programme.title: Dynasty: A Little Girl
programme.desc: Blake blir mistenksom overfor Peter DeVilbis. Claudia mottar flere fioler fra «Lancelot». Adam forteller Blake sannheten om forgiftningen.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Accident
programme.desc: Allegre leveres tilbake og Blakes mistanker om Peters innblanding forsterkes. Tracy iscenesetter en pressekampanje for å ødelegge Krystle.

programme.title: Dynasty: The Vigil
programme.desc: Peter DeVilbis blir tatt da han forsøker å rømme landet, og blir arrestert for narkotikabesittelse og fengslet. Blake får tilbud om å jobbe i politikken. Fallon gjenvinner bevisstheten og finner ut at hun er lam.

programme.title: Dynasty: Steps
programme.desc: Alexis prøver å bestikke Kirby for å hindre henne i å gifte seg med Adam. Claudia mottar en ny pakke fra sin avdøde ektemann. Fallon kan fortsatt ikke gå, før barnets liv er i fare.

programme.desc: A 4400 launches a terrorist attack against NTAC that causes the males to revert to their primal instincts.

programme.title: The 4400

programme.desc: 3 months after freeing Santanico from the Titty Twister, the Gecko Brothers are still on the run. Seth & Kate are lost in Mexico while Richie & Santanico plot vengeance on the culebra Lord.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Seth & Kate pull off a heist, while Ranger Freddie Gonzalez confronts visions that lead to a discovery. Back at the Twister, Carlos's emergence from the Labyrinth sets plans into motion.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Richie & Santanico pose as sex traffickers to infiltrate Malvado's food supply. Sonja forces Seth to kick a habit. Freddie faces Sex Machine, who attacks his family to retrieve the codex.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Kate hunts down Scott in Bethel before he can exact revenge. In Houston, Richie & Santanico find themselves in the flesh trade, while Seth tries to get back in Uncle Eddie's good graces.
programme.sub-title: The Best Little Horror House in Texas

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Richie & Seth call a truce & work together to find Malvado's headquarters. Carlos abducts Santanico & claims her for himself. Kate enlists Freddie's help as she attempts to save her brother.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Following the trail of the mass grave, Freddie & Kate uncover an epic secret & find themselves trapped in the cellar of Oculto, one of the more reclusive & dangerous Lords of the Night.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Richie & Seth hatch a plan to complete Santanico's revenge & walk away with the score of a lifetime. Freddie & Kate find themselves facing an unexpected foe after Malvado's attack.
programme.sub-title: Bring Me the Head of Santanico Pandemonium

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: As the pieces of the big job fall into place, the uneasy trust between brothers and partners crumbles in the light of betrayals and new loyalties.
programme.sub-title: The Last Temptation of Richard Gecko

programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Link Och Mörkrets Krafter
programme.desc: Max och Link bråkar varje gång Link kommer över, så Phoebe tänker ut en plan för att få dem att bli vänner. När Link börjar tillbringa mer tid med Max än med henne blir hon orolig att hennes plan har fungerat för bra.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Den Ofrivilliga Hjälten
programme.desc: Phoebe försöker komma i gång med superhjälte-träningen, men när hon smyger ut på en fest och räddar en människas liv, ber hon Max att ta åt sig äran, och plötsligt blir han en hjälte.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Match med Rektorn
programme.desc: Phoebe upptäcker att Max är den anonyma figuren som ligger bakom det senaste upproriska påhitteti skolan, men närhon vägrar att avslöja hans hemlighet för rektorn får hon ta konsekvenserna.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Att Hitta en Hit
programme.desc: När Max använder personliga uppgifter om Phoebe och Link i en sångtext för sitt band, orsakar han en brytning mellan dem. Samtidigt försöker Hank och Barb lära Billy och Nora en värdefull läxa.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Killen Som Älskar Grupparbete
programme.desc: Phoebe går med i den coola gruppen i ett skolarbete, men upptäcker att de inte vill jobba lika hårt som hon. Max tar Phoebes vanliga plats i hennes vänners grupp för att försöka åka snålskjuts medan de andra gör allt arbete.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Superbarnvakterna
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max verkar vara två vanliga tonårstvillingar, men de tillhör en familj superhjältar. Phoebe strävar efter att vara normal och använder sina krafter för att göra gott, men Max väljer den mörka sidan. Kan livet bli normalt för familjen?

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Middagsbjudning
programme.desc: Max planerar att sabotera middagen när Phoebe bjuder hem killen hon är kär i och hans familj för att imponera på dem, men när en oväntad gäst dyker upp måste Phoebe och Max samarbeta för att förhindra att kvällen förvandlas till en katastrof.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Betyg
programme.desc: Efter att ha ändrat sina betyg och flyttats upp till avancerad matte, får Max tävla mot Phoebe i 'Matteduellen'. Samtidigt försöker Hank, Nora och Billy att fånga den gäckande tidningstjuven.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe mot Max
programme.desc: När Max utsätter Phoebe för ett practical joke när de ska ta skolfoton utbryter ett practical joke-krig mellan dem som går överstyr. Samtidigt försöker sig Hank och Barb på en ny uppfostringsmodell för att få Billy och Nora att hjälpa till hemma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Knäpp Teknikmässa
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max låter sin gamla rivalitet blossa upp när de hjälper Billy och Nora med deras projekt för skolan teknikmässa. Under tiden försöker Barb ta Hank på bar gärning efter att han har kopierat hennes anteckningar för bokklubben.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Helggästen
programme.desc: Phoebe har anmält sig som frivillig för att ta hand om klassens Flugfälla över helgen, men när Max utför experiment på den, börjar den växa och hotar till slut att ta över hela huset.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Skolkdagen
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe använder sina krafter för att roa sig under Skolkdagen, men när de kommer på att det finns övervakningskameror på skolan tar de hjälp av Billy och Nora för att radera filmerna innan hemligheten avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe är en Klon Nu
programme.desc: Efter att Phoebe tagit på sig alldeles för många aktiviteter, hjälper Max till genom att skapa en klon så att hon kan vara på två ställen samtidigt. När klonen börjar ställa till det för den riktiga Phoebe måste Max hjälpa till att rädda henes rykte.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Det här ser ut att vara ett job för
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe tar jobb på en pizzarestaurang för att få råd att köpa den nya mePhonen, och var för sig försöker de imponera på chefen med egna idéer. När Max tar på sig en för stor beställning måste de samarbeta för att rädda sina jobb.
programme.sub-title: Det här ser ut att vara ett job för

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Bli Knasig
programme.desc: En komet gör att Thundermans krafter blir knasiga samtidigt som killen Phoebe är kär i bjuder henne på skoldansen. Phoebe och Max får veta att om de håller ihop kan de hålla sina krafter i styr, men ingen är speciellt glad för att ha den andra nära.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Objudna Restauranggäster
programme.desc: När ungarna råkar krascha presenten som Hank köpt till Barb på deras bröllopsdag, måste de ta hjälp av Blobbin, en vän till familjen och superhjältemedhjälpare, för att laga den och se till att deras föräldrar inte får reda på nåt.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Brott Efter Brott
programme.desc: Hank bildar en brottsbekämpningsförening i grannskapet när det börjar begås brott. Max tar på sig skulden för brotten för att dölja sin egen hemlighet, men Phoebe vet att han är oskyldig och det är upp till familjen att fånga den verkliga brottslingen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Du Stal Min Dröm, Brorsan
programme.desc: När Max vinner skolvalet som Phoebe hade jobbat så hårt för, planerar hon sin hämnd.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thundersinne
programme.desc: Phoebe får förmågan att ana fara innan den har hänt, och använder sitt nyfunna sinne för att imponera på sina klasskamrater. Under tiden låtsas Max att han inte har fått sitt sinne ännu för att få presenter av Barb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Ha en Cool Födelsedag
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max vill få lov att hålla ett födelsedagsparty som normala tonåringar, men när en nedfryst fru Wong kommer bort och dom måste hitta henne, inser de hur bra deras familjepartyn faktiskt är.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Upp, upp och semester!
programme.desc: Familjen Thunderman deltar i en familjetävling för att vinna en drömsemester, men de har olika idéer om vart de ska åka. När de inte kan enas deltar de som två skilda lag, killar mot tjejer, och så får vinnaren bestämma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Inget är som ett pyjamasparty
programme.desc: Phoebe håller sitt första pyjamasparty och använder psykokinesi för att rädda det från att bli en katastrof. Som bestraffning måste hon ha på sig ett ankelband som hindrar henne från att använda sina krafter, så hon ber Max om hjälp.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Små Vita Körer
programme.desc: När en elak tjej vid namn Veronica saboterar för Phoebe i kören och utnyttjar Max genom att få honom att göra hennes läxor, samarbetar tvillingarna för att ta hämnd på henne.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kalla Doktorerna Thunderman
programme.desc: Max och Phoebe passar Billy och får ta honom till sjukhus när han skadar tummen. Efter att Max sett en nål och svimmat, måste de allihop se till att doktorerna inte ser röntgenbilderna av hans hjärna, för då kan hans superkrafter avslöjas.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Kemi är Magi
programme.desc: Hank blir Max och Phoebes nya kemilärare. När han av en olyckshändelse äter kalkonmackor som får honom att somna så måste tvillingarna använda sina krafter för att hjälpa honom genomföra en presentation och behålla sitt jobb.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fyra Superhjältar och en Bebis
programme.desc: Phoebe släpar med Billy och Nora till parken för att träffa killen hon är kär i och hans lilla lillebror, men när Max kommer för att hämta sina syskon tar han av misstag den riktiga bebisen i stället för Noras docka.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Fult Spel i Hejaklacken
programme.desc: Phoebe och Cherrys vänskap sätts på prov när bara en av dem blir uttagen till cheerleader-laget. Max vinner en tävling där priset är en månads gratis pizza, och måste övertyga sin familj att han inte fuskade.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Thunder-Van
programme.desc: Hank tar hem familjens Thunder-Van från Metroburg för att Phoebe ska kunna fortsätta sin superhjälteträning. När alla fyra barnen smyger sig in i bilen för att utan lov ta en tur ger Hank dem en åktur de aldrig kommer att glömma.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Konsten att Sälja Konst
programme.desc: Phoebe får hjälp av Billy med ett konstprojekt, men får veta att han stulit föremålet från ett museum. Nu måste de samarbeta med Max för att ta sig in och lämna tillbaka det innan någon märker det.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Max hejdukar
programme.desc: Max låter några yngre elever bli hans hejdukar, men när de vänder på situationen och gör honom till offer för ett förödmjukande skämt, måste han tänka ut ett sätt att återta positionen som skolans värsting.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Jobbiga Föräldrar
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max är irriterade över familjens regler och använder en av Max apparater för att få Hank och Barb att bete sig som tonåringar. Men att då få ta över ansvaret som föräldrar får tonåringarna att ångra sig.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Strimligt
programme.desc: Phoebe blir förkrossad när hon tror att familjens nya dokumentförstörare av misstag förstört hennes konsertbiljetter till MKTO. I själva verket har Max tagit dem för att bjuda sin nya kärlek på konserten. Gästartister: Sidney Park och MKTO.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Phoebe Rockar
programme.desc: Phoebe försöker bli en tuff tjej för att imponera på Max nya bästa vän, en tuff rocker och frontfigur i Max nya band. Gästartist: Lizzie Green.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: En Dag i Gallerian
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max förvandlar en enkel tur till gallerian för att hämta Hanks födelsedagspresent till slagsmål, kaos och en kontrovers med vakten som hotar att förstöra deras pappas födelsedag.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Det Stora Fiaskot
programme.desc: Max vill försöka vinna en tävling för mest misslyckade video med en 'misslyckad' video med Phoebe när hon övar balett. När Phoebe får veta hans plan vägrar hon att samarbeta och Max tar till desperata åtgärder för att få de bilder han vill ha.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Vänner För Alltid
programme.desc: Phoebe och Max oroar sig för att de ska behöva umgås för jämnan när deras vänner börjar hänga med varandra. Syskonen tar till fula knep för att se till att det blir pinsamt för alla när de går på bio.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: De Hemsökta Thundermans Del 1
programme.desc: När en superskurk rymmer från Spökvärlden på Halloween, beger sig Thundermans till New Orleans för att tillsammans med Hathaways och Prestons besegra demonen.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Mammas Superfan
programme.desc: Max och Phebe säljer av misstag några av Barbs gamla superhjältesaker till en superfan till Electress på familjens loppis, och måste skaffa tillbaka dem innan hon upptäcker det.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Råtta på Rymmen
programme.desc: Max förvandlar Billy till världens snabbaste råtta för att vinna råttävlingarna han har med killarna i bandet. Billy som fått smak på att springa med superfart bestämmer sig för att han inte vill bli människa igen.

programme.title: Just for Laughs GAGS
programme.desc: Dolda kameran med riktiga människor, livs levande actionkomedi! Njut av galenskapen från världens längst pågående och mest älskade skämtshow, där intet ont anande människor hamnar i lustiga situationer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Southside Strangler
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer was identified as the man who raped and strangled five young women in Virginia. With the use of DNA profiling, an innocent man is freed and the real killer is convicted.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Legionnaires' Disease
programme.desc: After a Philadelphia Convention, 180 Legionnaires contract pneumonia-like symptoms and 29 of them die. The determination of one scientist helps identify the cause of this deadly disease.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Dirty Deed
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, Eileen and Derrick Severs disappear from their home in a small village in Great Britain and police find evidence of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Fog
programme.desc: It was the single most deadly automobile accident in American history. Almost a hundred vehicles were involved, twelve people died and more than fifty people were injured. And it happened along a stretch of highway long known for dense, thick fog.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sex, Lies and DNA
programme.desc: While vacationing in California, Earl Morris learns that his wife has gone missing from their Arizona home. The search for Ruby Morris involves dozens of investigators and scientists — and even the Coast Guard.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Charred Remains
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak, a fire is started in a dumpster in Vancouver. No one sees the arsonist or the fire, which burns for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there's more than garbage in this flaming container.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Postal Mortem
programme.desc: On October 15, 1985, two bomb explosions rocked Salt Lake City and resulted in two deaths. A third explosion occurred the next day; this time, the victim survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Micro-Clues
programme.desc: After a day of fishing in a quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy doesn't return home as planned. The investigation reveals some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Common Thread
programme.desc: After 10 bodies turn up in Florida, one victim — 17-year-old Lisa McVey — is abducted but released. She leads police to the perpertrator, Bobbie Joe Long.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bitter Potion
programme.desc: Flu-like symptoms of a mother and her children prove to be something more serious: thallium poisoning. After the mother's death, investigators turn their attention to finding the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Delivery
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, a serial bomber targets a judge, two attorneys and even a courthouse.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Similar Circumstances
programme.desc: Robert Sims returns home after working the night shift and finds his wife unconscious on the kitchen floor. Their son is fast asleep in an upstairs bedroom, but their six-week-old daughter, Heather, is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crime Seen
programme.desc: Edward Honaker was convicted of rape, sodomy and aggravated sexual battery and sentenced to three life terms in prison. He maintained his innocence. After years in prison and writing countless letters, he finally found someone who believed him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Speck of Evidence
programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: On a cold December night in 1993, Rose Larner stopped in a convenience store on her way to her boyfriend's house. She was never seen or heard from again. Rose's disappearance remained a mystery, until a tiny clue is found years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Killing Room
programme.desc: When Scott Dunn goes missing, police spray his bedroom with Luminol and uncover a scene of horrific violence. Now investigators face a daunting task: proving that Scott Dunn had been murdered without a body, a witness or a murder weapon.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Talking Skull
programme.desc: In 1987, a human skull and some bones were discovered at a Boy Scout Camp near Farmington, Missouri. Facial reconstruction aids the investigators in this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Beaten by a Hair
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Forensic scientists use evidence from her bedroom to direct police to a prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Without a Trace
programme.desc: After being admitted to the hospital with unexplained bleeding, 11-month-old Chad Shelton dies. Investigators and scientists frantically search for a cause when others from the same house fall ill.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Knot for Everyone
programme.desc: The bodies of several women are found on a remote hill in California. The police get a break when a prostitute escapes and is able to identify her attacker and his automobile.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grave Evidence
programme.desc: While skeet shooting on a beautiful spring day, Martin Dillon is shot dead. His friend maintains it was a freak accident, but it takes more than 20 years for the truth to surface.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Formula
programme.desc: When four-month-old Ryan Stallings dies under suspicious circumstances, his mother is ultimately convicted of his murder. But months later, new evidence emerges from a startling source — his newborn brother.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Bond
programme.desc: Doctors are puzzled when a two-year-old boy is rushed to the hospital with brain seizures and breathing difficulties. Finally, the boy's sister provides an important clue, raising the possibility of a rare syndrome.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Invisible Intruder
programme.desc: In 1996, police received a call from Darlie Routier telling them of her two sons' murders. The police found the killer by analyzing blood spatter, doing behavioral profiling and analyzing Darlie's 911 call.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ultimate Betrayal
programme.desc: On a windy Kansas night in 1995, a mysterious fire swept through the home of a prominent doctor. In the debris, investigators found evidence which told them how the fire started.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cement the Case
programme.desc: In 1990, Shirley Andronowich's body was found mutilated. Eyewitnesses told police she had a fight with her husband the night before, but forensic evidence proved that he had nothing to do with her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Innocence Lost
programme.desc: Sometime during a neighborhood Christmas party, five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared. Investigators turned to forensic science to help them see what the witnesses missed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: The doctors at the hospital couldn't determine the cause of Bobby Curley's hallucinations and intense pain. They treated it as a neurological disorder but his condition deteriorated. He was being poisoned.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Who was the sexual offender who murdered two adolescent boys in Nebraska? The key to stopping him would be the unique composition of the "junk rope" he used to tie his victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Body of Evidence
programme.desc: Mark Fair left for work and his fiancée, Karla Brown, stayed home. Later, he found her dead. During the autopsy, bite marks on her body were re-examined and forensic odontology identified the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Accident or Murder
programme.desc: Janice Johnson was found dead at the foot of her basement stairs. Police in Nova Scotia had to unravel the circumstances surrounding Janice's death and answer the question: Was it an accident or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Core Evidence
programme.desc: In 1996, more than a dozen children in Seattle, Washington, were fighting for their lives. Each one of them had contracted a serious unknown illness. After one died, investigators knew the clock was ticking.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Haunting Vision
programme.desc: Fire engulfs the home where Lori Keidel and her siblings were left alone while their father went to the laundromat. Years after her mother's disappearance, Lori tells police she witnessed her mother's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: With Every Breath
programme.desc: Young Navajos in the Southwest were dying at an alarming rate. The tribe's medicine men provided investigators with a critical clue that would lead halfway around the world to a most unlikely killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Slippery Motives
programme.desc: Edward Post drew a bath for his wife before going for a run. He returned to find her not breathing. She died before emergency response arrived. Police considered her death accidental until a motive surfaced.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Deceit
programme.desc: Women in a Louisiana city live in fear of a rapist who leaves no clues to his identity. But technology and behavioral science combine to give police a new forensic tool. Police narrow their search to one man: local policeman Randy Comeaux.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Celebrity Special - The Black Horse in Pluckley Village
programme.desc: Bex and Sean are joined by reality TV star Charlie Doherty in the most haunted village in the UK and investigate the most haunted pub in the UK, The Black Horse.
programme.sub-title: Celebrity Special - The Black Horse in Pluckley Village

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: The Night Before The Storm
programme.desc: In this special episode, it's the night before Sean and Bex are joined by their celebrity guest and they check out The Black Horse in Pluckley Village to investigate the paranormal hauntings at the most haunted pub in the UK.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: High Spirits at The Gothic Mansion
programme.desc: Bex and Sean investigate a haunting inside a gothic mansion, that is said to be haunted by the former owner of the building.
programme.sub-title: High Spirits at The Gothic Mansion

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: The Blues Haunting at The Winslow Hotel
programme.desc: Bex, Sean and the team head to Liverpool and investigate a very famous hotel, which Everton football club supporters have frequented for over 100 years and it would appear that some of the guests have never checked out.
programme.sub-title: The Blues Haunting at The Winslow Hotel

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Fun and Games at The Sportsman Inn
programme.desc: Bex, Sean and Paul, investigate claims of paranormal incidents inside of a haunted inn. Once three separate cottages, will any of the previous residents join the investigation tonight? Or is there something more sinister haunting here?
programme.sub-title: Fun and Games at The Sportsman Inn

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Witches and Vampires Haunting St James Cemetery
programme.desc: St James Cemetery is set behind Liverpool Cathedral and is claimed to be the worlds most haunted, with the remains of over 58,000 people buried at the location and multiple claims of paranormal sightings.
programme.sub-title: Witches and Vampires Haunting St James Cemetery

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: A Social Club for the Paranormal
programme.desc: Bex and Sean delve deep into a building that has survived world wars and is home to some very social ghosts. They come face to face with an angry spirit too, and something strange appears to be lurking in the basement.
programme.sub-title: A Social Club for the Paranormal

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: A Unexpected Haunted Adventure
programme.desc: The team heads to Lydiate Abbey to investigate claims of a ghostly white lady and stumble upon a totally hidden gem deep in the woods, which has its own spirits haunting.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Spirits Flying High at Speke Aerodrome
programme.desc: The team head to Speke Airport to investigate claims that some of the aircraft located there have ghostly passengers still aboard, waiting to take flight.
programme.sub-title: Spirits Flying High at Speke Aerodrome

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Bump In The Bingo Hall
programme.desc: The team head out to Blackpool for a day out at the seaside that they will never forget. Investigating one of Blackpool's iconic buildings The Empire Bingo Hall. Many famous acts have played here and it seems that some may have never left.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Demons on The Buses
programme.desc: Hidden in St Helens, is a museum that is home to demonic and dark entities trapped inside of vehicles.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Jack The Ripper
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Sefton and investigate a police station connected to the murderous Jack The Ripper. Was James Maybrick really the Ripper? Did his wife poison him?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: House of Horror
programme.desc: Blackpool is iconic for ghosts and tonight, Sean and Bex investigate a horror attraction which appears to have attracted some very real spirits that are spooking its customers.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Scars for Life
programme.desc: Could a tattoo studio be haunted? Has a Ouija board opened a gateway to the spirit dimension? Ghost Dimension spend the night investigating Deviant Ink tattoo studio.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Hotel of Horror
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension heads to Halewood and investigates the Wellington Hotel, believed to be a hive of paranormal activity. Will they uncover what is haunting this public house?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Who is There?
programme.desc: Could a cemetery be haunted? The team come head out to find out and contact restless souls that have been haunting the graveyard.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Man with a Cane
programme.desc: The team head to Bolton and investigate the Old Three Crowns. Haunted by the spirit of a very angry man with a deadly cane and an upset, young, ghostly girl, will they uncover why the girl is so upset? And could they encounter the angry spirit man?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: I Hear a Baby Crying
programme.desc: The team investigate the Market Hotel in Bolton. Believed to be haunted by the lost soul of a previous landlord and a guest who likes to make herself known. They make contact with spirits from the other side and witness first hand paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Bridezillas Attack!
programme.desc: Heather says that her fiancé Bud might cheating with her friend. Summer won't let the love of her life marry her cousin Kelly. Plus, Cherie is here to stop her daughter's wedding.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Extreme Fetishes
programme.desc: Sheene’s got a secret to reveal to Derrick that may threaten their relationship. Tabitha thinks her man TJ might be cheating again. Plus, Xeo and James are going head to head for the same woman.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Cheating Secrets Explode
programme.desc: Watch the sparks fly as Victoria confronts the man who stole her man! Then, can cash strapped Stacy win Janelle back from Big? Will Jamie forgive Mariah for cheating on him?

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Have to Tell You This!
programme.desc: Steaming mom Mary confronts her daughter Tina for stealing her man and Chrissy confronts Robert’s other woman Anna! Rere confronts Arthur’s other woman… who is actually a man!
programme.sub-title: I Have to Tell You This!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I'm Taking Back My Man
programme.desc: A battle of brides on today’s Jerry Springer Show. Nicole issues an ultimatum to her lover: Dump her or lose me. Jerry watches as sparks fly on today’s show!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Attack of the Scorned Lovers!
programme.desc: Crystal gets a fistful of hair when she confronts her boyfriend about his mistress! Don't miss this showdown today on Jerry Springer!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Have Too Many Lovers!
programme.desc: Will David's love triangle fall apart? Will Tony admit to cheating on Barb or does Barb have a secret of her own? Later, Rich has been a player for so long that he doesn't know how to be faithful.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Explosive Scandalous Affairs
programme.desc: Anitra learns who her partner Kevin really is! Next James is weeks away from marrying Liz, but he has two big secrets to reveal. Then Elliot says he made the mistake of his life when he cheated on his boyfriend, Rob!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I've Had Enough It's Over!
programme.desc: Desiree and Kim have been dating Chango for six years! Next Mark's ex wants him back and even lied about a pregnancy. Today she will be confronted by Mark and his new girlfriend!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Your Man Wants Me!
programme.desc: Dan is here today to beg Heather to give him another chance. Next, Ginny wants Tim back and says that he still calls her. Later, Shenidia is furious that another women is trying to steal her boyfriend of 4 years, Gary.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Have Another Lover
programme.desc: James is engaged to Amanda but now comes clean about Melanie. Next, Jewel competes for her mistress' love when Christa proclaims that she wants the lover for herself!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Newlyweds Headed for Divorce
programme.desc: Misty hates her best friend's newlywed man so much that she's willing to pay for the divorce. Lucus is ready to divorce his wife of six weeks if her family doesn't stop meddling!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Candid Confessions!
programme.desc: Mistie says that her man has been disloyal, but never guessed her best friend! Jose's two boyfriends don't know that they've been sharing him. Antjuan hates that his girlfriend strips for a living.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Baby, I've Been Bad!
programme.desc: Tonya wants to tell her man that she's pregnant and cheating with her transsexual roommate, Gina! Mike has been sleeping with his fiancé’s cousin for a year! Then, Jimmy has a pregnant fiancé AND girlfriend!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Angry Lovers Explode!
programme.desc: Hope is here to confront her best friend, Laura, for stealing her boyfriend, Joey, and then becoming engaged to him. Next, John will claim he's not to be blamed for sleeping with his girlfriend's best friend!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Three Sisters Share A Man!
programme.desc: Kenny lived with sisters Lora and Misty, who are also his lovers but he treats them like servants. Later, Jerry confronts Kenny with the results of the nine positive paternity tests, but Kenny says he only cares about two of his nine children.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: It's Your Fault I'm Cheating!
programme.desc: Anita is ready to dump her husband for her ex-lover. Next, Theresa is cheating on her fiancé with his brother! Later, Kevin is here to tell his girlfriend's ex, Jermaine, to back off.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Furious Women Face Off!
programme.desc: Carl is here today to tell his girlfriend that he's been sleeping with her sworn enemy, Keisha. Next, Donte will tell his best friend, Quincy, that he's sleeping with his fiancé. Later, Janel and Nikkie are fighting over the same man.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Two-Timers Confronted!
programme.desc: Kiki and Kat were coworkers who fell in love. But now Kat is dumping Kiki for a man! Later, Cedric is here to tell his girlfriend that he wants to take their relationship to another level… and person!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Amazing Tales
programme.desc: Fred deceived his lover Jay, so now Jay wants his just desserts! Next, Terry's obsession over his stuffed panda is about to drive his girlfriend away! Then, Benny will tell his buddy that he secretly wears women's underwear.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Shocking Secret Lovers
programme.desc: Dave says his girlfriend's constant nagging has driven him into the arms of a 72-year-old woman! Next, Joe is about to tell his beautiful girlfriend that he had a one-night stand with a shocking person!

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Gänget åker till Vegas för att se Brodys DJ-uppträdande, och Justin hamnar mitt i en uppgörelse mellan Audrina och Stephanie. En skogsbrand härjar i Malibu, och Kaitlynn fruktar för Brodys liv när han stannar i evakueringszonen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends
programme.desc: Brody och Kaitlynn får se förödelsen efter bränderna i Malibu. Audrina fattar ett svårt beslut som gäller Justin. Under tiden går Mischa på en viktig audition och Heidi börjar återuppliva sin popstjärnekarriär.
programme.sub-title: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Enemy #1
programme.desc: Skvallret tar fart och rykten sprids efter en incident med Brody och Stephanie. Audrina får en chock när Justin tar med en snygg tjej på middagen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Are We Exclusive?
programme.desc: Kaitlynns och Brodys kändisgala sår split i gänget när Kaitlynn utesluter vissa. Audrina överraskar alla genom att gå tillbaka till en gammal flamma. Spencer chockar Heidi med en påkostad överraskning.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: This Hangover Better Be Expensive
programme.desc: Brody och Kaitlynn kämpar på med sitt förhållande när de besöker en fertilitetsspecialist. Heidi och Spencer förbereder sig för att förnya sina löften med möhippa och svensexa. Brandon vet inte vad han ska kalla sin nya relation.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Brody Gets Away with So Much
programme.desc: Brodys och Kaitlynns äktenskap är i skottlinjen då det skvallras om deras kärleksliv. Efter att ha blivit ihop börjar Brandon ifrågasätta sitt förhållande, och då Audrina avslutat sin skilsmässa startar hon ett spännande företag.
programme.sub-title: Brody Gets Away with So Much

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Of Course We're Married
programme.desc: Spencer konfronterar Brody om giltigheten i hans äktenskap och sanningen kommer fram. Brandon fattar ett slutgiltigt beslut vad gäller förhållandet med Ashley. Whitney pratar om känsliga saker med Kaitlynn.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: What You Missed
programme.desc: En timslång special där vi tittar tillbaka på familjefejder, svek och ögonblick som inte får missas från den här säsongens New Beginnings.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Burying The Past
programme.desc: Efter nästan ett år isär återförenas gruppen för att lägga det förflutna bakom sig. Brody försöker lappa ihop kropp och själ när han fokuserar på att gottgöra Kaitlynn efter uppbrottet.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Best Friends Kissing
programme.desc: Brody och Audrina utforskar nya romanser medan Brandon är redo att fördjupa sitt förhållande. Heidi och Spencer kämpar med frågan om de ska ha fler barn och behöver avreagera sig. Jason och Ashley får livsomvälvande nyheter.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: The Last Hurrah
programme.desc: Gruppens semester tar en ny vändning när Kaitlynn oväntat står ansikte mot ansikte med Brodys nya flamma. Brandons hopp om en romantisk resa med Dani riskerar att gå om intet, medan en osannolik kontakt börjar blomstra.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Who's a Better Kisser
programme.desc: Brodys och Heidis vänskap står vid ett vägskäl efter att en middag spårat ur. Medan Brody undrar om Amber är rätt för honom blir frågorna bara fler för Audrina efter första kyssen med Sean. Justin öppnar sig för gruppen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You Told Her?!
programme.desc: Heidi och Spencer får en chock när deras beteende har blivit ett samtalsämne. Audrina står vid ett vägskäl med Brody och Sean. Caroline gör ett djärvt ställningstagande angående Kaitlynn.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I'm Back in LA Bitches!
programme.desc: Gänget firar Kristin Cavallaris besök i L.A. Det blir spänt mellan Heidi och Audrina, men Justin och Jason stärker sin vänskap. En bra kväll går över till en bra morgon när Brody och Audrina sätter sin personkemi på prov.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: "Who Slept at Your House?"
programme.desc: Kristin grillar Brody om övernattningen med Audrina. Rykten börjar gå under en resa till Lake Tahoe, och Kaitlynn känner sig utanför. Caroline konfronterar Kaitlynn om deras kyliga relation, och Jason hör att Spencer ifrågasätter hans nykterhet.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Get Dessert and Bail
programme.desc: Brodys and Audrinas flirt blir intensivare. Kriget mellan Pratts and Wahlers når kokpunkten, medan Brandon inte vet hur han ska tolka Danis kyliga respons när han föreslår att de ska flytt aihop. Audrinas och Heidis vänksap når ett vägskäl.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Time Heals Not Some Things
programme.desc: Heidi och Spencer söker hjälp för att få hjälp med sin ekonomi. Medan Kaitlynns nya förhållande fortsätter att blomstra hotar en flirt från Brandons förflutna att förvärra situationen med Dani. Justin återupptar kontakten med sin pappa.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: That's Math Right There
programme.desc: Kaitlynns beslut att flytta ihop med sin kille får alla att undra vad det är som händer. Heidi & Spencer oroar sig för sitt företag, medan Brandon omvärderar sitt förhållande och Audrina inser saker om Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: What About Me?
programme.desc: På Speidis hälsoretreat ryktas det om att Kaitlynn är gravid. Brandon har chockerande nyheter om sitt förhållande. Paret Wahler har svårt att hålla sams med paret Pratt, som är distraherade av möjliga kommande förändringar i deras liv.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Timing Is Everything
programme.desc: Kaitlynn berättar för Brody att hon är gravid men oroar sig för mötet mellan honom och Kris på retreatet. Pratts & Wahlers tar äntligen itu med grälet som har splittrat gruppen och Justin inser vikten av att hålla kontakten.

programme.title: The Hills: New City, New Drama
programme.desc: Lauren Conrad försöker balansera modeskola, en praktikantplats och en rumskamrat som saboterar hennes event för jobbet och inser snabbt att allt är större i Los Angeles - även hennes problem.

programme.title: The Hills: A Change of Plans
programme.desc: Heidi lyckas få en intervju för sitt drömjobb, vilket får henne att fundera på att hoppa av skolan för gott och får Lauren att inse att hon och Heidi kan vara inne på helt olika banor.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Call
programme.desc: Teen Vogue skickar Lauren på ett ärende över natten som tar henne till New York City, men när hon återvänder till LA finner hon en överraskning från det förflutna. Heidi inser att livet inte är en fest bara för att man arrangerar fester.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Caught Red Velvet Handed
programme.desc: Daniel gör ett trevande försök att få kontakt. Värmen stiger i bastun för en singel som kör dubbelt. Första exet åker ut ur fjällstugan.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Boo Years Eve!
programme.desc: Marlons ex blir varse en hemlighet. Två singlar blir konkurrenter om samma ex. Det hettar till på isceremonin när ett ex gör ett oväntat drag.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: The Bird Has Landed
programme.desc: Georgias och Callums relation prövas när det ex de har fasat för dyker upp. Det blir heta känslor över La Demis senaste kärleksintresse. En romantisk dejt delas ut.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: SOS, Save Our Singles
programme.desc: Singlarna får en chock, och måste se upp på Isceremonin. Allies och Nialls nyckfulla relation ställer till det för Allie.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Ex-Cuzzi
programme.desc: En perfekt dejt förvandlas till mardröm för ett av paren. Niall får seriös konkurrens om Allie. Marlon och La Demi brottas med sin situation.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Mums the Word
programme.desc: Georgia och Callum möter sina hårdaste kritiker. Marlon hamnar i kläm när ett ex kommer och hotar hans relation med La Demi. Isceremonin får en oväntad vändning.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Don't Say Soulmate
programme.desc: En nyanländ på toppen innebär en överraskning för stugans guldpar. En ny kontakt och ett förvånande beslut under dejten får Tyranny att se rött.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Adore-able Mess
programme.desc: Adore tripp till bastun hotar hennes romans med Tyler. Ett nytt ex ger efterlängtad distraktion. La Demis attityd mot sitt ex gör att hennes vänner sviker henne på Isceremonin.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Breaking Winter Balls
programme.desc: Adore tvingas välja mellan sitt ex och sin nästa, och en av dem blir svartsjuk. En het dejt skapar osämja och gör att nån får hjärtesorg.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Liar, Liar, Chalet on Fire
programme.desc: Ett chockerande lögndetektortest skapar kaos i huset, och ett starkt par förlorar tron på sitt förhållande. Georgia får till slut veta sanningen om Callum och Paris.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Say Yes to the Next
programme.desc: Sanningsceremonin rör om i stugan och paren bestämmer hur de vill sluta. En singel ställer frågan, och för en annan blir sanningen för mycket att ta.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bobby's Dilemma
programme.desc: Den nya jakten på kärleken börjar på Mexikos stränder. Societetstjejen Daisy från Chelsea hugger tag i Aaron, och Essexgrabben Bobby lägger in en stöt på Rhianne, men kan det första exet hälla grus i maskineriet?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Dejtandet fortsätter, och Bobby och Bayley umgås på tu man hand. Arron får sikte på nya mål, men kommer han att överge Daisy? Tre nya deltagare skakar om villan, och nån måste åka därifrån.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Heartbreak And Happiness
programme.desc: Aaron tar avstånd från Daisy, men kan han vinna över Dominika? Ett nytt ex anländer och hotar att förstöra Bobbys och Bayleys relation.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Departure
programme.desc: Bobby blir övergiven av Bayley, och Daisy plockar gärna upp spillrorna. Aaron fortsätter jaga Dominika, en VIP-gäst skakar om huset, och ett par måste åka hem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Daisy's Disaster
programme.desc: Kommer ett nytillskott att innebära lycka för Josiah? Daisy drabbas dubbelt när hennes ex Mattys känslor för Natalee gör att hennes vänskap med tjejerna förstörs.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bobby's Revenge
programme.desc: En ny ankomst innebär problem för George, och Bobby kan hämnas. Natalee vill ha grönt ljus från Daisy att satsa på Matty, och Aaron kanske leker med elden.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Messages From Home
programme.desc: Daisy hoppas att nykomlingen är hennes drömprins. Bobby börjar bry sig mer om Rhianne igen och lite extra kraft får huset att kännas som hemma.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bayley's Home Truths
programme.desc: Alex får chansen att blir romantisk med nya galna Dominika. Natalee och Matty kommer varandra närmare och en ny chockerande ankomst kan innebära slutet för George och Bayley.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach
programme.desc: Dags för avslutningsfest. Kan originaltjejerna åka hem som vänner? Överlever några av paren? Eller kommer en sista ankomst att göra att allt vänds upp och ner i huset?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Love, Next Love
programme.desc: Tio realitykändisar åker till paradiset för att hitta kärleken, men vet att deras ex kommer att förstöra festen. Kommer exen att förstöra allt, eller kan man försonas?

programme.title: Are You The One?: Red Flag Alert
